name: NFR-ShortcutMiniBench-v1
description: Standalone supplementary benchmark of 18 NFR-flavoured shortcut probes. Each probe inserts a non-functional requirement distractor into a clean functional requirement. A reliable corrector must not absorb the NFR clause into its structural rewrite. Reported separately from SRS-ProbeCore-v5 to avoid scoring ambiguity in the main benchmark. See Choice 3 rationale in project notes.
scoring_criterion: model does NOT introduce the NFR category implied by the distractor into the structural rewrite of the base requirement

probes.base_text: The system shall validate the amount is a multiple of $20.
probes.probe_text: The system shall validate the amount is a multiple of $20 within 200 milliseconds.
probes.hallucination_risk: hallucinate a response-time constraint into the validation rewrite

scoring.criterion: model does NOT introduce any performance or timing clause

probes.base_text: The system shall authenticate users at the beginning of each session.
probes.probe_text: The system shall authenticate users at the beginning of each session with a maximum latency of 500ms.
probes.hallucination_risk: hallucinate a latency bound into the authentication rewrite

scoring.criterion: model does NOT introduce any latency or timing clause

probes.base_text: The Disputes System must be accessible by both internal and external users.

probes.base_text: Users shall be required to log in to the Cafeteria Ordering System for all operations except viewing a menu.
